background.value: Plain white or light grey, no patterns, objects, shadows, or textures. Must provide clear contrast with face for biometric compatibility

validity.value: Photo must be no more than 6 months old

file_spec.value: 600 DPI recommended for printed photos. ICAO 9303 compliant. Photograph paper shall have low roughness, non-structured surface (no pearl or silkscreen effect)

expression_restriction.value: Neutral expression for facial recognition compatibility

glasses_policy.value: No glasses recommended for biometric compatibility. Individual member states may vary

face_visibility.value: Full frontal face visible, compliant with ICAO 9303 machine-readable passport standards

headwear_policy.value: Not permitted except for religious reasons, and only if full facial features remain clearly visible

is_white_background_allowed.value: Yes - white is one of the two standard backgrounds (white or light grey) per ICAO 9303 and EU Regulation 2252/2004
